must_not_claim: I was wrong to attempt Klank

turns.content: Klank was my unfinished project: a node-based interface for orchestrating local language models, kind of like N8N for local LLM messaging. I could not finish it because the pieces did not exist or did not connect in a way I could bridge then. For a long time I thought that meant Klank was just failure. Later, seeing tools like OpenClaw and Mission Control solve similar problems reframed it. Klank was a correct idea I could not yet build. It taught me that being early to a problem is not the same as being wrong about it.
That makes Klank a failed build but not a failed instinct.
